metadata.title: SMPDL v2.6: A Three-Layer Dependency-and-Logic Audit for Mathematical Proofs and AI-Generated Claims — 146 Curated Sample Reports
metadata.description: This release expands the Göttingen S/M/P × D/L curated corpus from 141 to 146 Markdown reports by adding the Andrews-Curtis human checklist, three OpenAI withdrawal-event audits, and the arXiv paper source. It also fixes stale internal DOI references and an attribution table formatting issue. The archive contains all 146 reports plus the attribution/fingerprint file.
